activity.statutory_purpose: Eie og drive barnehage i Enebakk til beste for medlemmene.

summary: HAUGLIA BARNEHAGE SA (org. no. 877 476 472) is a cooperative (SA) based in Enebakk, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1997-04-23. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 85.100 (Førskoleundervisning og drift av barnehager); it has 21 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 13.1 m and net income was -NOK 24 101. CEO: Anita Grytvik Kjær; auditor: HØILUND REVISJON AS.
